title: DevOps & Deployment Pipelines
description: Master modern DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment strategies for PEGA applications

content.introduction: Modern PEGA applications require robust DevOps practices to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure deployments. This lesson covers comprehensive DevOps strategies including CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, deployment automation, and monitoring.

sections.title: CI/CD Pipeline Architecture
sections.content: Design comprehensive CI/CD pipelines that automate the entire software delivery lifecycle from code commit to production deployment. Understand pipeline stages, quality gates, and deployment strategies.
pipeline: Source code management and version control
Deployment to staging and production environments

sections.title: Automated Testing Strategies
sections.content: Implement comprehensive automated testing including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and performance tests. Understand testing frameworks and best practices.

sections.title: Deployment Environments
sections.content: Configure and manage multiple deployment environments including development, testing, staging, and production. Understand environment-specific configurations and data management.

sections.title: Configuration and Secrets Management
sections.content: Manage application configurations and sensitive data across environments. Understand configuration management tools, secrets management, and environment-specific settings.

sections.title: Monitoring and Observability
sections.content: Implement comprehensive monitoring and observability to track application performance, identify issues, and optimize deployments. Understand logging, metrics, and alerting.

sections.title: Deployment Strategies
sections.content: Implement modern deployment strategies including blue-green deployments, canary releases, rolling updates, and rollback mechanisms to ensure reliable deployments.
